response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack web developer with strong TypeScript/Node.js and some systems-level D and C/C++ background, but he does not meet several hard requirements: there is no indication of native-level Japanese proficiency, no Linux kernel investigation or modification experience, no embedded networking or LAN-switch product work, and no exposure to the listed security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal) or networking protocols (NETCONF, SNMP, Telemetry). His career trajectory centers on web platforms and product engineering, not embedded firmware security.
strengths: Long, varied engineering career with some low-latency systems work (DLang, async I/O) at Dunnhumby
Prior C/C++ experience on developer tooling at National Instruments and Linux familiarity
Strong testing culture (TDD, CI/CD) and open-source contributions
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency, a hard requirement for the role
No embedded networking, LAN-switch, or security-protocol experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF)
No demonstrated Linux kernel analysis or source-modification experience; recent work is entirely web-focused

key_factors.factor: General systems programming background (C/C++, DLang, Linux)
